card.name: Period in section number 5.x
card.fires_on: The period after the digit 5 in a label section number such as 5.6 or 5.10, at the start of a Warnings and Precautions subsection heading. Also one case of the digit 5 before a vial size.

modes.label: Section 5 decimal point
modes.description: The period in a Warnings and Precautions subsection number, right after a bracketed cross-reference and before a new heading.
modes.example: [see Use in Specific Populations ( 8.4 )]. 5<<.>>6 Hypomagnesemia Intravenous

modes.label: Digit before vial size
modes.description: The digit 5 giving a vial strength in preparation instructions.
modes.example: Reconstitute the <<5>> g vial of hydroxocob

card.plain: It marks the dot in subsection numbers like 5.6 that open each warning heading in a drug label.
